title: aaps prompted rebuild when installed on new device, then did not promp when reinstalled on old device. Now 60 days have passed and aaps has not reverted to LGS
body:
- Issue occurred September 11/2022 8:13pm PST
- was having phone issues so installed aaps onto a new device temporarily, then uninstalled aaps on old device, then reinstalled aaps on old device when the device was fixed
- when I installed aaps on the new device I got a prompt to rebuild: "New version for at least 174 days available! Fallback to LGS after 60 days, loop will be disabled after 90 days"
-  when I switched back to the old device and reinstalled aaps the notification did not come again 
- it has now been 72 days and aaps has not fallen back to LGS
-
Build version 3.0.0.1
